# Testhooks

> A tool to test webhooks: catch one, change its payload, reply with any status, watch the sender react. Everything the UI does is an API call, so a script or an AI agent can do it too, with the same words and defaults.

This file is served by every Testhooks, including this one. Paths below are on this server.

## On this server

- [OpenAPI document](/api/openapi.json): every REST call, served without a token.
- Capture URLs are `/h/{slug}`. Send any HTTP request there and it is captured.
- If the server has an `AUTH_TOKEN`, send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on `/api/` calls. A `READ_TOKEN` can list, read and wait but not create, change, delete or send.

## The typical agent session

1. Create an endpoint: `POST /api/endpoints`. Give its capture URL to the webhook provider.
2. Wait for the request instead of polling: `GET /api/endpoints/{id}/requests?after={lastRequestId}&wait=30`. A timed-out wait is a normal 200 with an empty list, so call again.
3. Read exactly what the provider sent, and get a type for the payload from `/api/requests/{reqId}/types` or `/api/endpoints/{id}/types` (TypeScript, Zod, JSON Schema, Go, Pydantic).
4. Write the handler to match. Preview any transform or reply script on that request before saving it.
5. Send a test request, or replay the captured one, to check the handler.

## Easier ways in

- [MCP server](https://sarathsp06.github.io/testhooks/guides/mcp/): `testhooks mcp` gives Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client these steps as tools.
- [Command line](https://sarathsp06.github.io/testhooks/reference/cli/): `testhooks endpoints create`, `testhooks requests wait`, `testhooks requests types`.
- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/sarathsp06/testhooks/blob/main/skills/testhooks/SKILL.md): when to use which call.
